# Tromme

> Tromme is a dedicated music player app for Plex Media Server on iPhone and iPad. It offers lossless streaming, word-synced lyrics, crossfade, offline downloads and CarPlay, and it works with any standard Plex account with no Plex Pass required.

Tromme requires iOS or iPadOS 27 or later and a Plex Media Server. It is not affiliated with Plex, Inc. Tromme does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data; the Plex token is stored in the iOS Keychain on the device.

## Features

- No Plex Pass required: Works with any standard Plex account
- Customizable Home: Choose and reorder Plex hubs
- Lossless streaming: FLAC files are transcoded to lossless ALAC for accurate playback
- Crossfade: Free, with a length of 3, 5, 7 or 10 seconds
- Magic Mix and Infinite Mode: Endless playlists and queues based on style, genre and mood
- Word-synced lyrics: Highlight word by word, saved with downloads for offline use
- Offline downloads: Songs, albums, playlists or the whole library, plus Music Cache
- Concerts on artist pages, genre/style/mood tag editing, and Siri ("Play Abbey Road in Tromme")
- Album details, Sound Check, cellular-aware transcoding and CarPlay

## Tromme Plus

Tromme is free to use. The optional Tromme Plus subscription adds AutoMix (smart crossfades timed from the last lyric of one song to the first of the next), premium app icons, animated album artwork, track trim and higher bitrate downloads.
